trend.neutral: colors the change indicator as neutral, independent of the value's sign
trend.up: colors the change indicator as positive
trend.down: colors the change indicator as negative

rules.trend: Pick trend by whether the change is good or bad news, not by whether the number itself is positive or negative.
rules.animate: animate only runs when value is a finite number; pass an object ({ from, duration, whenVisible }) instead of true to customize the count-up, and it honours prefers-reduced-motion automatically.
rules.format: Pass format to override the default locale, tabular formatting used for each tick and the final value.
